engine: giant-word fill-width sizing. Harvested from live EVER (ever-live-here.com).

measured_live_EVER.model: word width = viewport - 2*gutter, ALWAYS. EVER's hero word is an SVG logo (viewBox ratio 3.525) stretched to that width; height follows the ratio. gutter ramp ~= clamp(20px, 3.6vw, 70px).

fit.what: live TEXT (any word, any length) sized so its ink fills (containerWidth - 2*gutter)*fill. Two-pass: probe-measure via an off-screen clone (NOT scrollWidth — that is clamped by the container, the classic text-fit trap), set the size, then re-measure the real ink width and correct once (em letter-spacing scales with size, so one correction converges to <0.5%). Re-fits on resize (rAF-debounced) and on font load.
fit.use: OUR case — different words (quadro/архітектура/тераса) must each fill the same width with their own font-size.

vector.what: a fixed-ratio brand word mark ( logo): width = calc(100% - 2*gutter); height:auto -> follows the intrinsic ratio. This is EXACTLY EVER's hero-logo behaviour. No per-frame JS.
vector.use: one fixed brand word as a vector logo.

gutter.what: side padding the word fills to; number (px) or fn(viewportWidth)->px. Default = EVER's measured ramp.

fill.what: fraction of (width - 2*gutter) the ink fills. 1 = flush to the gutters.

maxFontPx.what: clamp ceiling for the computed font-size.

probePx.what: probe size for the first measurement pass.

entry: FluidType.fit(el, opts) | FluidType.fitAll(selector, opts) | FluidType.vector(el, opts) | FluidType.refit(). All fits auto-track and re-fit on resize / font load.
law: SIZES type only (font-size / width); does not animate. Pairs with section-pager + bleeding-wordmark. Off-screen clone measurement + rAF-debounced refit -> no layout thrash. NO WebGL.
proven: lab fits 3 different-length Ukrainian words (quadro 335px / архітектура 240px / тераса 401px @1440) ALL to 100% of target width; re-fits correctly at 768 and 1920. (asset-substitution gate vs EVER's single logo.)
